title: Adding A Video Above The Fold Of The Homepage | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: Adding A Video Above The Fold Of The Homepage Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/5000686290 First, hide the entire first section by navigating to Settings >> Design Settings >> Search Box / Call to Action >> Hide Entire Section : Add the video as Custom Homepage Content. To start this process, navigate to Content >> Webpage Builder >> Edit Homepage : Add the Video using the Coding Icon < > In order to make the video larger and match the width of the rest of the elements in the homepage, replace the width and height: Also make sure to remove or add a different Title H1 and Subtitle H2: The last step will be to call this section as custom homepage content. To do this navigate to Settings >> Design Settings >> Homepage >> Select Content to Display >> Select: Custom Homepage Content Now you can Visit the Site, the end result is the video above the fold: For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
